BiblicalUsage: Jesimael is Jesimiel, an Israelite of Simeon. In 1 Chronicles 4:36, Jesimiel, and Benaiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesimiel matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
